title: Galen Digital-Coverage Census (First1KGreek)
description: A structured, machine-readable digital-availability census of the Galenic Greek corpus as digitized in the Open Greek and Latin Project's First1KGreek repository: 103 editions across 97 distinct works (~2.4M words of Greek), with CTS URNs, word counts, working subject categories, and Scaife reader links. Scope is digital availability of Greek text only; translation status, authenticity, and non-Greek witnesses are out of scope.
